_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against the bugfest reference baseline of 3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-circulation container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-circulation container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-circulation container in MiB

deployment.description: mod-circulation supports horizontal scaling. Kafka consumer groups coordinate shared event processing, while circulation-rules update consumers intentionally run once per module instance.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for mod-circulation API requests.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options applied to the mod-circulation process.

EnvVars.name: SCHEDULED_ANONYMIZATION_NUMBER_OF_LOANS_TO_CHECK
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of loans examined in one scheduled anonymization run.

EnvVars.name: ENABLE_FOR_USE_AT_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Enables reading-room circulation for items restricted to use at their location.

EnvVars.name: HTTP_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of connections in each Vert.x HTTP client pool.

EnvVars.name: ECS_TLR_FEATURE_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables ECS requests feature. Must be set to `true` for LoC.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host used by the module's event consumers and producers.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port used by the module's event consumers and producers.

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Kafka topic replication factor used when the module creates topics during tenant activation.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name used as the prefix in Kafka topic names.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Okapi base URL used for outbound calls made while processing Kafka events.

EnvVars.name: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum Kafka message size in bytes accepted by the module's Kafka clients.
